inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, a caregiver inappropriately grabbed a child by the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, children were placed in restrictive devices for extended periods. One child for 10 minutes, another child for 11 minutes, and a third child for over 40 minutes,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2805(10))

occurrences.finding: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, children who were not sleeping were required to remain on mats without being provided with a quiet alternate activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §746.2907(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Caregiver Must Face Child and Be Within Arm's Length of Child: A caregiver was observed turning their back to a child on a diaper changing table to talk to another child and give them a bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Caregiver Must Face Child and Be Within Arm's Length of Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The directors record was reviewed and current training in allergy response and hazardous materials was not available for review.    NOTE: The last documents training availalbe was observed to be completed 6/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: The operations emergency prepoaredness plan was reviewed and observed to be missing the following;    The first responsibility of staff in an emergency evacuation or relocation is to move the children to a designated safe area or alternate shelter known to all employees, caregivers, parents, and volunteers;      (B) How children will be evacuated or relocated to the designated safe area or alternate shelter, including specific procedures for evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments;      (C) The staff responsibility in a sheltering/lock-down emergency for the orderly movement of children to a designated location within the center where children should gather;      (D) An emergency evacuation and relocation diagram as outlined in ?746.5207 of this title (relating to Must I have an emergency evacuation and relocation diagram?);      (E) Name and address of the alternate shelter away from the center you will use as needed; and      (F) How children in attendance at the time of the emergency will be accounted for at the designated safe area or alternate shelter.        The emergency telephone number that is on file with us; and      (B) How you will communicate with local authorities (such as fire, law enforcement, emergency medical services, health department), parents and CCR   How your staff will evacuate and relocate with the essential documentation including:  (A) Parent and emergency contact telephone numbers for each child in care;  (B) Authorization for emergency care for each child in care; and  (C) The child tracking system information for children in care;       (4) How your staff will continue to care for the children until each child has been released;     (5) How you will reunify the children with their parents as the evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: The operation did not have an evacuation diagram posted near the exit of the building
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A mesh fence was added to the playground to separate the play space from the air unit. The fence was observed to be falling, the air unit and other hazardous materials were accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Fire extinguisher was observed to be on the floor in the front unsecured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: After a diaper change, the caregiver did not have a child wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment: A caregiver was observed changing 2 diapers and did not sanitize the diaper changing table in between.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was observed changing 2 diapers and used gloves. The careigiver was observed using gloved and did not remove the gloves and wash their hands in between the diaper changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: Two seat belts were observed to be stuck and could not be buckled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads: A play yard was observed to have 5 additional mattresses/foam padding addedd.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Of the 9 staff records reviewed, 8 did not have training in responding to food allergy reactions. 9 did not have training in handling hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One caregiver hired 12/2022 did not have documentation of 24hours of annual training completed for the 2023-2024 training year
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Staff in the infant and prek rooms were not aware of the ages of children in their care. In the infant room, when asked, the caregiver stated the children were 9-13mo. When asked later for the individual ages to determin specified age group(SAG), the caregiver then stated the youngest in care was 4mo and the oldest was 20 months. In the prek room. The caregiver stated the children were 3-5yrs. When asked for individual ages of children to determin SAG, the caregiver stated there were 10-15 3yr olds in care and 5 5yr olds. Staff present continuned to provide in consistent information on the ages of children in their care. One caregiver stated there were no 5yr olds in care.    NOTE: The birthday wall posted only listed the ages of 14 children
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: One crib was observed to have two mattresses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: The van used to transport children was evaluated, one seatbelt was not observed to be operating properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Several safety hazards were observed on the playground to be used by children, including pesticides, broken, loose boards, exposed rebar/screws, metal rake, screwdriver, and ant hills. broken areas of fencing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside: Evacuation plans were observed in 5 newly added spaces, the plans did not include a designated location inside the building in the event of shelter in place/lock down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location: Evacuation plans were observed in 5 newly added spaces, the plans did not include a designated location away from the building
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: 10 of the 15 children being transported did not have emergency medical information available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: 2 booster seats used were observed to have an expiration date of 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: The outdoor space to be used by children was not observed to be fully fenced. A shipping container was observed to be used to close off space
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: Of the 6 children's records reviewed, one child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have an allergy plan of file
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: Children's product's safety certificate was last completed 5/3/2022
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One caregiver recieved online CPR with no hands-on training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Of the 6 children's records reviewed, one child did not have the address listed for an emergency contact
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Of the 6 children's records reviewed, one child did not have a special needs statement completed
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: 2 sheets were observed to be loose. One sheet was observed to be tied in knots under the mattress causing the ends of the mattress to bend.    NOTE: Corrected at inspection.  The walking infant was removed from the crib and placed on a mat. The other mattress/sheet was removed from the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 4 month old infant was observed to be in a crib with a blanket and a bottle of milk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: 3 infants between the ages of 14mo-16mo were placed in cribs with bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: 3 cribs in the infant room were observed to be loose.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement: Cribs in the infant room were not observed to have enough space. Three infants in cribs were observed to be able to touch each other from their cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement (26 TAC §746.2403(4))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Sleeping Equipment: 3 sheets used infant cribs were observed to be soiled and stained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Sleeping Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Written feeding instructions for a 4 mo old not yet on table food was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Fire extinguisher was observed to be in the box and not secured
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food: A bag of carrots and an avacado was observed to be open and uncovered in the refrigerator.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food (26 TAC §746.3317(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Of the 11 records reviewed, 3 children did not have a special needs statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Of the 11 children's records reviewed, 6 did not have an address listed for the emergency contact, 1 did not have a name listed, and 2 children did not have anyone listed as an emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Of the 11 records reviewed, 5 children did not have a health statement on file signed by the parent or a health care professional
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: Documentation a caregiver with no previous experience received 24hrs of pre-service training was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Of the 3 staff records reviewed including the director, none of the staff had a notarized affidavit on file available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Documentation that two caregivers received orientation was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: A 20 mo old was observed sleeping in a crib with a bib around their neck.    NOTE: Corrected at inspection. The bib was removed from the child
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2501(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A 14 mo infant was observed in a baby walker.    NOTE: Corrected at inspection. The walker was removed from the classroom
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Transportation training for the director was not observed to be current.     NOTE: Training observed expired 1/27/22
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Of the 11 records reviewed, one child did not have emergency medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Emergency medical information was not available for one child being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Parents' Information: Of the 11 records reviewed, 1 child did not have the name of the parent listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Parents' Information (26 TAC §746.605(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: First aid kit was observed to be missing cotton balls, scissors, tweezers, and a thermometer.     NOTE: Corrected at inspection, all missing items were placed on the van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster (26 TAC §746.401(7))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Notice-Keeping Children Safe (26 TAC §746.401(3))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)
